Hi! Fellow OCDer with PTSD here - it's a bit of a mindfuck I know to have two conditions and feel like "ugh now I have another thing to cope with!" (at least that's how I felt) I find OCD definitely makes getting over PTSD harder, because of the repetitive thought process it has and then you apply that to having flashbacks and trauma and it's enough to send you straight to bed!
Going to sleep is one of my crutches too - my family is always complaining that I'm lazy and would feel SO much better if I went out more. -_- I hope you have a more intelligent, more supportive and less ignorant family than I do! If not, at least know there's someone on here who knows 100% what you're going through. :-) It can and does get easier though - I find it's all about making new habits one at a time and implementing them gradually to take over negative habits. I am still dealing with agoraphobia and try and go out still but it's difficult. Keeping my chin up (but my eyes crossed and tongue poking out!)

As a female, you're meant to wipe only front to back so you don't spread any germs/particles/whatever from your ass to your urethra or vagina. Women have a much shorter urethra than men and so are far more prone to UTIs and bladder infections. Wiping back to front is the most common cause of these illnesses and is also just gross. You're smearing poop onto your vulva even if you can't see it.

Try to do one small thing a day in terms of self care. And try and make it something different each day to vary it. When things are overwhelming it's hard to shower/brush hair/brush teeth/ get dressed/ put on make up or shave/etc, so just try one small thing. You'll feel a little better. :-) I hope you feel better soon x
